daily.today_energy: Mercury's got you feeling sharp and a little introspective. This is your moment to untangle some mental clutter and emerge with clarity. Trust the quiet wisdom bubbling up.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, today's about showing up authentically—no performance needed. Single? Someone might pick up on your grounded energy. Either way, vulnerability hits different rn.
daily.career: Your attention to detail is basically a superpower today. Channel that into something that matters to you, even if it's small. Quality over hustle—always.
daily.health: Your nervous system's asking for gentle care. Maybe that's a walk, journaling, or just permission to do less. Listen to what your body's quietly requesting.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to release perfectionism and embrace the beautiful mess of being human. Mercury's vibes are helping you communicate what's been stuck in your throat. Trust the unfolding.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled or single, vulnerability is your superpower rn. Stop overthinking those texts and let yourself feel without analyzing. Someone's noticing your realness, and that's what magnetizes connection.
weekly.career: Your organizational skills are about to shine, but the real magic happens when you collaborate instead of controlling every detail. Let others surprise you with their approaches. Innovation loves a shared workspace.
weekly.health: Your body's asking you to slow down and actually listen to what it needs. Move in ways that feel good, not punishing. Hydration and sleep are your quiet power moves this week—treat them like non-negotiable rituals.
